decisions.reason: The shop relaunch SEO service ties directly into the firm's core relaunch business and has kept its own page across both years, so it likely meets aspirations at low cost in a growing industry and gives no reason for problemistic search.

The SEO workshops are new and their results are still uncertain, but they draw on existing SEO expertise at little extra cost, and the firm's slack from industry growth allows it to carry them while performance is observed.
